findings.title: Untrusted GitHub event content is passed into an AI prompt or command
findings.message: Untrusted GitHub event content is passed into an AI prompt or command
findings.why: PR bodies, issue bodies, comments, branch names, and commit messages are attacker-controlled in common workflows and can contain prompt-injection instructions.
fix: Avoid inserting raw GitHub event text into prompts.
Use structured extraction and length limits.
Add prompt-injection filtering before AI execution.
Run the agent with read-only permissions.

findings.title: AI-related action is not pinned to a commit SHA
findings.message: AI-related action is not pinned to a commit SHA
findings.why: Tag-pinned third-party actions can change over time. AI-agent actions often receive privileged context, so supply-chain drift matters.
fix: Pin third-party actions to full commit SHAs.
Prefer first-party or internally mirrored actions for privileged jobs.

findings.title: AI agent runs on pull_request_target
findings.why: pull_request_target runs in the base repository security context and can expose write tokens or secrets to workflows influenced by an untrusted pull request.
fix: Use pull_request with read-only permissions for untrusted code.
Split analysis into a read-only job and a separate maintainer-approved write job.
Avoid checking out untrusted PR head code in pull_request_target.
findings.evidence: AI usage is reachable on pull_request_target

findings.title: AI agent job has access to secrets
findings.message: AI agent job has access to secrets
findings.why: Secrets mounted into an AI-agent job can be exfiltrated if untrusted prompt content influences tool use, shell commands, or generated output. Most AI actions require a provider key, so this is a baseline exposure to review rather than a vulnerability on its own — it becomes high-risk when combined with untrusted input or write permissions (see agentci/untrusted-ai-write-token).
fix: Do not expose secrets to agent jobs that process untrusted content.
Move secret-bearing actions behind manual approval.
